_why: Only one SOH model can be compiled at a time, so the two firmware sizes cannot both come from a live build. Both were measured on 2026-08-31 with arm-none-eabi-size on images built from the same source, differing only in mcu/soh_tables.h, and both were flashed and benchmarked.

cnn.elf_note: same source with the preserved CNN header; 3 seeds x 10,945 parameters
cnn.note_2026_08_31: Retrained through the deterministic pool (soh_cnn.pool_to_8): pooled 0.0135 -> 0.0135.  AdaptiveAvgPool1d had no deterministic CUDA backward, so every earlier CNN fit was irreproducible; the replacement is the same function on this input (AvgPool1d(4), verified max|delta| 0).
